summary: Vivani Medical's subsidiary Cortigent will merge into ClearOne's wholly owned subsidiary via a stock-for-stock deal. Cortigent equity held by Vivani will be exchanged for 12.5 million ClearOne shares; no cash consideration or premium percentage is disclosed. The transaction is conditioned upon ClearOne raising $10–15 million via a registered offering of units comprising one share and a warrant exercisable at $10 for six months. ClearOne is a Nasdaq-listed Nevada company. The filing lacks a board recommendation or named advisors. Watch: ClearOne's ability to complete the required S-1 financing and shareholder approvals.
